summary: The gold is sonnet's transcription (via the interrupted draft) with the omitted I.1 orbit figure added and all ten figure boxes re-measured on the page pixels, because every candidate crop was missing on disk; text, answers and the Задача III solution were verified field by field against the pages. Haiku and GLM both drop all 40 multiple-choice options and mislocate or clip most figures (haiku also has two wrong answer keys and heavily garbled prose; GLM has an invalid problemType, an invented note and no I.10 schemes figure), so all three candidates fail, sonnet only for the missing figure plus two clipped/over-reaching boxes. Of the 21 checker findings, 20 are confirmed and one (GLM's claim that sonnet's схема 1/схема 2 captions are cut off) is a false positive; the checkers also missed sonnet's missing figure, GLM's missing options and most of haiku's and GLM's bad boxes. Nothing on the pages is illegible; the only point worth a human glance after figures.mjs runs is the I.10 schemes crop, whose top margin is forced to 2 px by the print layout.
